englishDefinition: to become worse in quality, condition, or value

contexts.text: Air quality in large urban areas has deteriorated rapidly over the last decade.
contexts.translation: 大城市地区的空气质量在过去十年中迅速恶化。

contexts.text: If governments fail to regulate emissions effectively, environmental conditions may deteriorate further.
contexts.translation: 如果政府无法有效监管排放，环境状况可能会进一步恶化。

contexts.text: Public satisfaction usually falls when transport services deteriorate.
contexts.translation: 当交通服务恶化时，公众满意度通常会下降。

productionPrompt.instruction: Write one Task 2 sentence explaining how living conditions can deteriorate when public services are underfunded.
